verdict.rationale: Parahelp's Customer Agent can use tools built on any API-backed service, such as Stripe or your own internal endpoints, and non-engineers can build them. Connected tools are shared across agents, and guardrails reference account-aware behavior such as enterprise-account routing and refund amounts, so answers can draw on live customer systems rather than only knowledge articles. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of lookups for plan, order status, or account history in answers; independent or hands-on corroboration that live-data answers work in practice.
